title: Reversing one arc to make a tournament diconnected
statement: Let $D$ be a tournament on a finite, nonempty vertex set $V$. Then either $D$ is diconnected, or there is an arc $x \to y$ of $D$ whose reversal makes it so: deleting the arc $x \to y$ and inserting the arc $y \to x$, while leaving every other arc unchanged, yields a diconnected digraph.
hypotheses_covered: D is a tournament (an orientation of the complete graph)
